(Domb and West 57 are sometimes referred to as “Party' Or "Parties".) WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, West 57 is the owner in fee of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, located in the Borough of Manhattan, City, County and State of NewYork.known as Lot 27 in Block 1010 on the Tax Map of the City of NewYork, and by the street address of 105-107 W. 57h Street, New York, New York, and more particularly described on Exhibit A annexed hereto and made a part hereof (said lands and tax lots being herein collectively called the "West 57's Land,"said buildings and improvements being herein called the "West 57's Building, and the West 57's Land and the West 57's Building being herein collectively called the "West 57's Premises"); West 57's Land and Domb's Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the “Parcels” and each individually as a “Parcel” and West 57's Premises and Domb's Premises are herein sometimes jointly referred to the “Premises"); WHEREAS.West 57 may desire in the future to construct a replacement of or new West 57's Building (the “New Building") on West 57's Land with a Bulk (as hereinafter defined) in excess of the Bulk presently permitted to be constructed on West 57's Premises under the Zoning Resolution(as hereinafter defined); WHEREAS,West 57 and Domb desire to combine, all in accordance with the terms and conditions of this Agreement. the zoning lot containing West 57's Premises with the zoning lot containing Domb's Premises into a single zoning lot (the "Combined Zoning Lot") to facilitate West 57's ability to utilize exclusively the Excess Floor Area Development Rights (hereinafter defined);
